notes.title: Countryside Life is coming to STEAM!!!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33140164/1bb3fcc56e5213bea8ff40d5d226213803747fc5.png[/img]


[h1][Story][/h1]
Hiro takes a trip to visit his relatives in the countryside where he will spend 1 month in this new and relaxing environment. There, he is reunited with his childhood friends, 3 vivacious and attractive sisters who re very excited to have him there.  

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33140164/46ab9484eae60f1d8b16ea80e06b16551d8bf384.png[/img]

[h1][Gameplay][/h1]
Spend the month earning the affection of the sisters, or spend time enjoying the country life. Go fishing, do some cooking, make a secret base, help those around you, enjoy country life to the fullest and make some memories on the way.

notes.title: Alma and the Fragments of Cursed Memories
notes.notes:
[img]https://shared.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3338550/header.jpg?t=1732255249[/img]


[h2]Prologue[/h2]

Alma used up her funding for magic research one day.
She resigned herself to going to the tavern to take on a
simple commission, but the one she was recommended was suspiciously short on details.

Alma was enticed by its reward money,
though, so she went to meet the client and learn the details of the job...

[img]https://shared.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3338550/ss_44cbb7576daeb0f25850a6238949196ce89ec9f6.600x338.jpg?t=1732255249[/img]

[h2]Game Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Traditional RPG turn based combat 
[*] Gorgeous pixel graphics
[*] Various side quests
[*] Exp based skill tree
[/list]

[img]https://shared.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3338550/ss_419836a3595a685f5343654e51e14f412a6af0b1.600x338.jpg?t=1732255249[/img]
